class.name: IfcRelConnectsPortToElement
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelConnectsPortToElement defines the relationship that is made between a port and the IfcElement , or IfcElementType in which it is contained. It is a 1 to 1 relationship. The IfcRelConnectsPortToElement established a whole part relationship between the element and its port.
